flow_summary: The interview covers all required sections with one question at a time and correctly loops on repeatable items (meds, family history) until the patient says none remain. However, it repeatedly demands exact-format repetitions after the patient has already supplied the information, and responds to hedging or uncertainty with rigid instructions rather than gentle clarification or acceptance.

issues.evidence: "Please repeat your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format." after patient already said "I think it’s 21/03/1986."
"Please answer yes or no." after patient gave a nuanced "I think so — my family doctor assessed me back in 2021..."
"Please repeat your email address." when patient explicitly asked which of two addresses to use.
